rules.condition: if slot == 1 then return not busy and G.targets_within(self, 1, yell_radius(L)) ... return classic_answer
rules.semantic: Classic: an orc bot HOWLs (and tries EAT CORPSE) whenever a foe is within 130 px. Gameplay Fixes: HOWL wants the orc not busy and a body the yell can stun (a living foe or a generator) inside the yell's own radius; the classic foe search still runs first for its draws.

arms.when: fixes on, target inside yell radius
fixes on, foe within 130 but outside the yell

tests.note: classic_row(orc, 1, false, "ORC HOWL", busy, idle): fixes on, busy => false

rules.condition: if slot == 2 then return G.hp_below(self, 3, 5) and G.corpse_underfoot(self, 24) ~= nil
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: an orc bot EATs a corpse when it is below 60% health with a stain under it (within the meal's squared reach 24), whatever the foes are doing; classic asked only for a foe within 130 and let the meal itself refuse.
